keySentence: He cut the leather at night.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The shoemaker was tired. He cut the leather. He went to sleep. He cut the leather at night.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The tired shoemaker worked until late in the evening. He cut the leather at night under the dim candlelight. He shaped the pieces perfectly for a pair of shoes. He hoped someone would buy them the next day. The moon was bright as he placed the leather on the table. He fell asleep not knowing a surprise was waiting for him.
facts.Word cards: cut = 자르다 / leather = 가죽 / carefully = 조심스럽게 / precious = 소중한
